Game Overview

In Draw To Pee, the core idea is straightforward: guide your character to the toilet in a thrilling race against time. Strategize and sketch paths to avoid obstacles, testing your quick thinking and creativity. With escalating challenges and charming visuals, immerse yourself in this whimsical adventure where each successful level brings relief and a new set of puzzles.
